findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Observed that the back door was letting in some daylight at the bottom, indicating that the door was not tight-fitting as to protect against the entry of insects. PIC was informed and stated that there was a previous protective piece in place that is no longer there, and will work on getting it replaced by the next routine inspection. Ensure that outer openings of food establishments protect against entry of pests by filling gaps and having tight-fitting exterior doors.
findings.citation_text: 6-202.15(A) Outer Openings, Protected. (A) Except as specified in (B), (C), and (E) and under (D) of this section, outer openings of a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by: (1) Filling or closing holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings; (2) Closed, tight-fitting windows; and (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors. [C]

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed triple sink to have a leak present from faucet. PIC stated that a whole new apparatus is on order. Inspector will return on or by Wednesday, 13 May 2026.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(B) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed sanitizer solution to test at greater than 200 ppm CL. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer bottle was remade and tested at 100 ppm CL. Ensure a sanitizer solution is available and at the proper concentration during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A).

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: Observed leak to be present at the bottom of front prep cooler. Discussed with PIC, cooler will be serviced. Ensure equipment is maintained to be working up to the manufactures standards.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed prep cooler to be soiled with small amounts of food debris accumulation under lid. Discussed with PIC, prep cooler lid will be cleaned. Ensure non food contact surfaces are being cleaned at a frequency that prevents food debris accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Observed triple sink to have a leak present from faucet. Discussed with PIC, sink will be serviced. Ensure a licensed plumber services triple sink and that no leak is present.
findings.citation_text: 5-202.11(A) Approved System and Cleanable Fixtures. (A) A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be designed, constructed, and installed according to LAW.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
(Repeat x2) Observed the following require repairs:

(1) The wall panel holding the paper towel dispenser at the front hand washing sink is lifting up on the left side. The panel needs to be sealed to the wall to make a smooth, easily cleanable surface. 

Ensure these locations are repaired to be smooth and easily cleanable by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Observed employees that were cleaning (or doing other tasks) put on gloves to prepare foods without handwashing first. The PIC was instructed to educate employees about washing hands before donning gloves to engage in food preparation. Ensure that employees always wash hands before donning gloves.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (A) After touching bare human body parts other than clean hands and clean, exposed portions of arms; (B) After using the toilet room; (C) After caring for or handling SERVICE ANIMALS or aquatic animals as specified in 2-403.11(B); (D) Except as specified in 2-401.11(B), after coughing, sneezing, using a handkerchief or disposable tissue, using TOBACCO PRODUCTS, eating, or drinking; (E) After handling soiled EQUIPMENT or UTENSILS; (F) During FOOD preparation, as often as necessary to remove soil and contamination and to prevent cross contamination when changing tasks; (G) When switching between working with raw FOOD and working with READY-TO-EAT FOOD; (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed the front hand washing sink and customer bathrooms do not have ‘employees must wash hands before returning to work’ signs. The inspector provided signage to the PIC. Ensure that all hand washing sinks always have proper signage that notify employees to wash hands.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.14 Handwashing Signage. A sign or poster that notifies FOOD EMPLOYEES to wash their hands shall be provided at all HANDWASHING SINKS used by FOOD EMPLOYEES and shall be clearly visible to FOOD EMPLOYEES.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Observed eggs stored on the top shelf of the double cooler over various ready-to-eat foods. The PIC was notified and they moved the eggs onto the bottom shelf. Ensure that raw foods are always stored below ready-to-eat foods to avoid cross contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
Observed the following must be cleaned: 

(1) The dusty ceiling vent above the double cooler. 

(2) The shelves drying clean dishes next to the triple sink. 

Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Ensure that the ceiling vent and drying racks are to cleaned to sight and touch by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
Observed eggs being stored over ready-to-eat foods (including, but not limited too, pepperoni and veggies). The eggs were moved below the ready-to-eat foods during the inspection. Ensure that foods are protected from contamination by storing them according to their correct storage order. 

3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the shelves over the triple sink holding clean dishes are soiled with debris. Ensure that non-food contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of soil residues. 

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
Observed the drain underneath the triple sink is backed-up. When the entire triple sink is emptied the water that is not able to drain goes onto the floor. When inspectors arrived the ware washing area was wet with a larger accumulation of water around the drain. Ensure that plumbing systems are maintained in good repair. There will be a follow-up on 08/26/2024 to ensure that the water from the triple sink is able to drain when emptied.

5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed holes in the wall by the back ware washing area (i.e. triple sink room). The holes were mostly up high near the ceiling. The holes must be filled (ex. Fill with caulk). There is also cracked and missing tile still present in the ware washing area. This is a repeat violation from the previous inspections on 7/22/22, 3/7/23, 7/28/23, 12/21/23, and 3/2/2024. Repair the above area to be smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. 

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.
